provenance.prediction: Existing saved offline BASE-policy predictions, no task LoRA, no steering, no robot execution. This export ran neither inference nor training.
provenance.observed_hands: Observed human landmarks retargeted to Wuji; not measured robot joint encoders.
provenance.future_hands: 15 saved predicted poses; rendered steps 0,7,14, with later poses translucent. Ground-truth future arrays exist in the source record but are NOT rendered.
provenance.coordinates: 3D source data in the anchor RGB camera frame, metres; retargeted Wuji joints in radians. Masks in image pixels.
provenance.horizon: Paper calls this a 4.5-second chunk. Saved targets are anchor+1,+4,…,+43 source frames (0.1–4.3 seconds).
provenance.input_cloud: Dense visual is a display rendering of measured stereo depth, not the 5,000-point model input. Saved 5,000-point samples become roughly 3,700–3,941 voxelized points before the 512-token encoder.
provenance.object_visual: RGB cutout illustrates the segmented object. The model consumes the black/white segmentation-mask image, not this RGB appearance.

privacy: Source names, absolute paths, user names and original file metadata omitted. RGB and cloud detail crops exclude room context and product labels. Paper assets retain published backgrounds; no unblurred face identified. No new deployment imagery was generated.
rights: Research assets supplied for this project. Source paper and YOR/Wuji geometry attribution apply; no new license or independent third-party rights audit is asserted.
